
```jsx
import { CxFormLabel } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxFormLabel from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/form/CxFormLabel'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **customClassName** | A string of all className you want to be applied to the component, and override standard className value. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
